Look 22, SPLENDID BRAZIL – NYFW Spring '27 Runway Collection. 95.5% Polyester, 4.5% Elastane. Lining: 96% Polyester, 4% Elastane. BOD35704

items.name: COPACABANA CROCHET TOP (RUNWAY)
items.description: Bikini entallado a mano en algodón negro, con un patrón de trabajo abierto intrincado que juega con la textura y un efecto de corte sutil. El escote limpio, ajustado y la largo corto uniforme naturalmente con los pantalones de ganchillo a juego para un conjunto coordinado.
items.description_en: Fitted bikini top hand-crocheted in black cotton, with an intricate openwork pattern that plays with texture and a subtle sheer effect. The clean, fitted neckline and cropped length pair naturally with the matching crochet pants for a coordinated set. Look 3, SPLENDID BRAZIL – NYFW Spring '27 Runway Collection. 94.5% Cotton, 5% Viscose, 0.5% Elastane. Lining: 87% Polyamide, 13% Elastane. TOB35707

items.name: JACQUARD WHITE SHORTS (RUNWAY)
items.description: Los cortos de longitud de las Bermudas en jacquard blanco fuera, cortados con una cintura estructurada y una pierna relajada y recta terminada con franja y detallando la rifa para una textura agregada.
items.description_en: Bermuda-length shorts in off-white jacquard, cut with a structured waistband and a relaxed, straight leg finished with fringe and ruffle detailing for added texture. Look 10, SPLENDID BRAZIL – NYFW Spring '27 Runway Collection. 100% Polyester. Lining: 95% Polyester, 5% Elastane. BER35767 *Styling note: Waist tie shown was used exclusively for runway styling and is not included with this piece.

items.name: JACQUARD ROSÉ SHORTS (RUNWAY)
items.description: Corta cortos de longitud de las Bermudas en jacquard rosa claro, cortado con una cintura estructurada y una pierna relajada y recta que se sienta justo encima de la rodilla. Detalle de la rifa inclinada añade dimensión suave a la forma a medida.
items.description_en: Bermuda-length shorts in light pink jacquard, cut with a structured waistband and a relaxed, straight leg that sits just above the knee. Tiered ruffle detailing adds soft dimension to the tailored shape. Look 8, SPLENDID BRAZIL – NYFW Spring '27 Runway Collection. 95% Polyester, 5% Elastane. Lining: 100% Cotton. BER35763 *Styling note: Waist tie shown was used exclusively for runway styling and is not included with this piece.

items.name: MIDNIGHT BLOOM EMBROIDERED FLORAL MIDI DRESS BLACK
items.description: Made in Brazil. 85% poliamida, 15% elastano.
items.description_en: Made in Brazil. 85% Polyamide, 15% Elastane. Hand wash. Do not bleach. Do not tumble dry. Dry flat in the shade. Do not iron. Do not dryclean. VEM34310

items.name: BETINA TWEED JACKET
items.description: El Betina Tweed Blazer está elaborado en tweed dorado, embellecido con apliques florales de cristal dispersa y oro en todas partes. Cuenta con un escote sin cuello recortado con detalles de cristal y dorado, cierre frontal de cremallera, mangas largas, y un bolsillo de solapa frontal para una silueta pulida y femenina.
items.description_en: The Betina Tweed Blazer is crafted in gold-flecked tweed, embellished with scattered crystal and gold floral appliqués throughout. It features a collarless neckline trimmed with crystal and gold beaded detailing, front zip closure, long sleeves, and a front flap pocket for a polished, ladylike silhouette. Made in Brazil. 93% Polyester, 4% Viscose, 3% Cotton. Hand wash, do not bleach or tumble dry. Dry flat in the shade. CAS34570

items.name: BETINA TWEED MINI SKIRT
items.description: La Betina Tweed Skirt está fabricada en tweed dorado para que coincida con el blazer de coordinación, embellecido con los mismos apliques florales de cristal y oro dispersos. La mini silueta ofrece una base limpia y clásica que permite que el embellecimiento tome el escenario central.
items.description_en: The Betina Tweed Skirt is crafted in gold-flecked tweed to match the coordinating blazer, embellished with the same scattered crystal and gold floral appliqués. The mini silhouette offers a clean, classic base that lets the embellishment take center stage. Made in Brazil. 93% Polyester, 4% Viscose, 3% Cotton. Hand wash, do not bleach or tumble dry. Dry flat in the shade. SAC34569

items.name: LUMA JACQUARD JACKET
items.description: La chaqueta Luma Jacquard ofrece una sofisticada y femenina toma en una silueta utilitaria. El estilo cuenta con una longitud alargada, un amplio collar estructurado, y mangas de manguito voluminoso terminado con esposas reunidas que realzan el movimiento de la pieza.
items.description_en: The Luma Jacquard Jacket offers a sophisticated and feminine take on a utilitarian silhouette. The style features an elongated length, a wide structured collar, and voluminous puff sleeves finished with gathered cuffs that enhance the movement of the piece. A gathered finish at the waist defines the silhouette while balancing the volume. A metallic front zipper adds contrast and a contemporary touch to the floral jacquard. Composition: 90% Polyester, 10% Metallic Fiber / Lining: 95% Polyester, 5% Elastane. Made in Brazil. Hand wash, do not bleach or tumble dry. Dry flat in the shade. Do not iron or dryclean. JAQ34513

items.name: TINA KNIT PANTS
items.description: Los pantalones Tina Knit cuentan con una construcción clásica y precisa con una silueta recta y un ajuste elegante. El estilo cuenta con una cintura alta, lazos de cinturón, pleats frontales y bolsillos laterales funcionales, junto con bolsillos traseros destetados que refuerzan el acabado refinado.
items.description_en: The Tina Knit Pants feature a classic and precise construction with a straight silhouette and elegant fit. The style features a high waist, belt loops, front pleats, and functional side pockets, along with welted back pockets that reinforce the refined finish. The front closure combines a zipper, interior button, and metal hooks for a structured and secure fit. The straight hem and slightly cropped length complete the silhouette with a contemporary touch. Composition: 96% Polyester, 4% Elastane / Lining: 95% Polyester, 5% Elastane. Made in Brazil. Hand wash, do not bleach or tumble dry. Dry flat in the shade. Do not iron or dryclean. CAL34618

items.name: BIANCA LACE LONG SLEEVE MINI DRESS
items.description: El Bianca Lace Long Sleeve Mini Vestido cuenta con un escote de cuello alto y hombros estructurados, con mangas de encaje y ilusiones de corpiño dando paso a un amorcito bulltier debajo. La espalda abierta está terminada con un tapiz y cierre de cremallera, mientras que la falda oxidada atada añade volumen y movimiento juguetón a esta romántica mini silueta.
items.description_en: The Bianca Lace Long Sleeve Mini Dress features a high mock neckline and structured shoulders, with sheer lace sleeves and bodice illusion giving way to a sweetheart bustier underneath. The open back is finished with a keyhole cutout and zipper closure, while the tiered ruffled skirt adds volume and playful movement to this romantic mini silhouette.. Made in Brazil. 100% Polyamide. Hand wash, do not bleach or tumble dry. Do not dryclean, do not iron. VEC34592

items.name: TINA KNIT TOP
items.description: La Tina Knit Top traduce una artesanía excepcional en una silueta estructurada con fuerte impacto visual. El estilo cuenta con un escote corazón, correas finas ajustables y una forma ajustada, con lados limpios que resaltan aún más el bordado frontal intrincado.
items.description_en: The Tina Knit Top translates exceptional craftsmanship into a structured silhouette with strong visual impact. The style features a sweetheart neckline, adjustable thin straps, and a fitted shape, with clean sides that further highlight the intricate front embroidery. The standout detail is the exceptionally rich and intricate handwork, crafted with rhinestones in various shapes, crystals, and jewel-like buttons individually applied to create dimension, intense shine, and an almost fully ornamented surface. A back zipper completes the design. Made in Brazil. TOP34506

items.name: LUMA JACQUARD MINI SKIRT
items.description: La Luma Jacquard Mini Skirt destaca la estructura de la tela en una silueta femenina con volumen de declaración. El estilo cuenta con una cintura alta y una forma ajustada a través de las caderas, abriendo en un amplio óxido recogido en el dobladillo para crear un efecto con movimiento y ligereza.
items.description_en: The Luma Jacquard Mini Skirt highlights the structure of the fabric in a feminine silhouette with statement volume. The style features a high waist and a fitted shape through the hips, opening into a wide gathered ruffle at the hem to create a flared effect with movement and lightness. The jacquard's floral pattern enhances the visual richness of the piece, while an invisible zipper at the back provides a discreet and sophisticated finish. Made in Brazil. Hand wash, do not tumble dry or bleach. Do not dryclean or iron. SAC34515

items.name: LUMA JACQUARD CORSET TOP
items.description: El Luma Jacquard Corset Top destaca la estructura de la tela en una silueta femenina y delicadamente equipada. El estilo cuenta con un escote recto ligeramente redondeado, correas finas ajustables y paneles que contornan el busto y definen la cintura, creando un ajuste preciso.
items.description_en: The Luma Jacquard Corset Top highlights the structure of the fabric in a feminine and delicately fitted silhouette. The style features a slightly rounded straight neckline, adjustable thin straps, and panels that contour the bust and define the waist, creating a precise fit. Rich hand-embroidered rhinestones adorn the upper portion of the piece, adding shine, texture, and a sophisticated artisanal finish. A metallic zipper at the back completes the design. Composition: 90% Polyester, 10% Metallic Fiber / Lining: 95% Polyester, 5% Elastane. Made in Brazil. Do not wash, bleach, tumble dry, iron, or dryclean. Dry flat in the shade. Wetclean, very mild. Specialized laundry only. TOP34516

items.name: ANTONIETTE COVERUP
items.description: La Cubierta de Antoniette es la pieza de declaración final para la playa a la barra. Fabricada en 100% viscosa con un estampado floral romántico en tonos azulados, corales y oro, cuenta con una silueta de kimono relajado con un cierre frontal de corbata en la cintura.
items.description_en: The Antoniette Coverup is the ultimate statement piece for beach to bar. Crafted in 100% viscose with a romantic floral print in blush, coral, and gold tones, it features a relaxed kimono silhouette with a tie-front closure at the waist. Long fringe with beaded pearl accents cascades from the hem, adding movement and a touch of bohemian luxury to every step. Made in Brazil. 100% Viscose. Hand wash, to not tumble dry and do not bleach. Do not dryclean or iron. SPM34090

items.name: ISADORA KNIT BEADED MIDI DRESS
items.description: El vestido de Isadora Knit Beaded Midi pare un escoop escote con franja entallada que se envuelve sobre los hombros y traza el escote tanto delante como espalda. Su silueta de punto ajustada se extiende a una longitud de midi elegante, ofreciendo un lienzo limpio para el detalle entallado para tomar el escenario central.
items.description_en: The Isadora Knit Beaded Midi Dress pairs a scoop neckline with cascading beaded fringe that drapes over the shoulders and traces the neckline both front and back. Its fitted knit silhouette extends to a sleek midi length, offering a clean canvas for the beaded detail to take center stage. Made in Brazil. 97% Polyamide, 3% Elastane. Hand wash, do not bleach or tumble dry. Do not dryclean or iron. VEM34576

items.name: LUMA JACQUARD BLAZER
items.description: El Luma Jacquard Blazer reimagina el clásico a medida con una elegante construcción rica en textura. El estilo cuenta con una longitud alargada, mangas largas rectas y hombros subtly estructurados que añaden presencia a la silueta.
items.description_en: The Luma Jacquard Blazer reimagines classic tailoring with an elegant construction rich in texture. The style features an elongated length, long straight sleeves, and subtly structured shoulders that add presence to the silhouette. Wide, defined lapels reinforce the sophisticated finish, while covered buttons in the same jacquard fabric stand out against the front closure while preserving the continuity of the floral pattern. Composition: 100% Polyester / Lining: 95% Polyester, 5% Elastane. Made in Brazil. Hand wash, do not bleach or tumble dry. Do not iron or dryclean. BLA34691

items.name: ANTONIETTE BODYSUIT
items.description: El traje de Antoniette Body trae elegancia y sensualidad en una pieza impresionante. Fabricado en tejido floral con una base rosa suave, cuenta con una taza de bustier estructurada y correas finas ajustables.
items.description_en: The Antoniette Bodysuit brings elegance and sensuality in one stunning piece. Crafted in floral-print fabric with a soft rosé base, it features a structured bustier cup and adjustable thin straps. At the back, a cutout detail is finished with a gold buckle, adding a sophisticated, modern touch. High-cut leg lines enhance the silhouette. Buckle closure. Made in Brazil. 92% Polyamide, 8% elastane. . Hand wash. Do not bleach. Do not tumble dry. Do not dry clean.

items.name: THEREZA TULLE MINI DRESS
items.description: El vestido de Thereza Mini cuenta con recortes estratégicos y detalles para crear una silueta llamativa y femenina. El estilo cuenta con una línea de cuello V profunda, mangas largas y cortes laterales anchos que revelan la cintura, mientras que la espalda abierta se termina con un botón en el escote.
items.description_en: The Thereza Mini Dress features strategic cutouts and sheer details to create a striking and feminine silhouette. The style features a deep V-neckline, long sleeves, and wide side cutouts that reveal the waist, while the open back is finished with a button at the neckline. The bodice has a fitted shape before opening into a short skirt with lightweight, delicately voluminous layers. An invisible zipper at the back completes the design. Composition: 65% Recycled Polyamide, 21% Polyamide, 11% Metallic Thread, 3% Elastane / Lining: 95% Polyamide, 5% Elastane. Made in Brazil. Hand wash, do not bleach or tumble dry. Drip dry flat in the shade. Do not iron or dryclean. VEC34507

items.name: LUMA JACQUARD FEATHER MINI DRESS
items.description: El Luma Jacquard Feather Mini Dress transforma la riqueza de la tela en un estilo sofisticado con un fuerte impacto visual. El diseño cuenta con un escote más alto, una silueta cortada y una espalda abierta con un corte de teardrop, terminado con botones cubiertos en el escote y una cremallera invisible en la parte posterior.
items.description_en: The Luma Jacquard Feather Mini Dress transforms the richness of the fabric into a sophisticated style with strong visual impact. The design features a halter neckline, a short fitted silhouette, and an open back with a teardrop cutout, finished with covered buttons at the neckline and an invisible zipper at the back. Hand-embroidered rhinestones add shine and texture around the neckline and in strategic areas throughout the piece, reinforcing its artisanal character. Feather appliqués at the hem add volume, lightness, and movement to the design. Composition: 90% Polyester, 10% Metallic Fiber / Feathers: 100% Ostrich Down / Lining: 95% Polyester, 5% Elastane. Made in Brazil. Do not wash, bleach, tumble dry, iron, or dryclean. Dry flat in the shade. Wetclean, very mild. Specialized laundry only. VEC34512

items.name: ISADORA KNIT BEADED MINI DRESS
items.description: El Isadora Knit Beaded Mini Dress cuenta con un escote de scoop con franja de cascading entallado en los hombros y escote, frente y espalda. La silueta de punto mini equipado ofrece una base limpia y elegante que permite que el detalle abatido tome el escenario central.
items.description_en: The Isadora Knit Beaded Mini Dress features a scoop neckline with cascading beaded fringe draping across the shoulders and neckline, front and back. The fitted knit mini silhouette offers a clean, sleek base that lets the beaded detailing take center stage. Made in Brazil. 97% Polyamide, 3% Elastane. Hand wash, do not bleach or tumble dry. Do not dryclean or iron. VEC34577

items.name: TINA KNIT MINI DRESS
items.description: El vestido Tina Knit Mini traduce la sofisticación y el impacto visual en una construcción que destaca la artesanía artesanal en cada detalle. Con un llamativo escote de parada, la pieza revela elegantemente la decoración contrastando con una espalda dramáticamente abierta para crear una silueta femenina y contemporánea.
items.description_en: The Tina Knit Mini Dress translates sophistication and visual impact into a construction that highlights artisanal craftsmanship in every detail. Featuring a striking halter neckline, the piece elegantly reveals the décolletage while contrasting with a dramatically open back to create a feminine and contemporary silhouette. The design is finished with an invisible zipper at the back and covered buttons at the neckline. The standout detail is the exuberant hand embroidery, crafted with rhinestones, beads, and pearls meticulously applied to contour the body with a sculptural effect. Composition: 96% Polyester, 4% Elastane / Lining: 81% Polyamide, 19% Elastane. Made in Brazil. Hand wash, do not bleach or tumble dry. Dry flat in the shade. Do not iron or dryclean. VEC34597

items.name: OLGA TULLE MINI DRESS
items.description: El vestido Olga Tulle Mini trae una combinación impresionante de brillo, movimiento y elegancia femenina. Elaborado a partir de tul delicado con hilo metálico, el diseño cuenta con un escote de alto nivel y un corpiño ajustado adornado con rayas dotadas brillantes que crean un efecto vertical sutil.
items.description_en: The Olga Tulle Mini Dress brings a striking combination of shimmer, movement, and feminine elegance. Crafted from delicate tulle with metallic thread, the design features a high halter neckline and a fitted bodice adorned with shimmering dotted stripes that create a subtle vertical effect. The open back is framed by a long scarf-like tie that drapes elegantly down the silhouette, adding movement and drama. A defined waist leads into a voluminous, tiered mini skirt, creating a playful yet sophisticated finish. The sheer tulle overlay enhances the lightness of the silhouette while adding depth and texture to the design. Composition: 87% Polyamide, 8% Metallic Thread, 5% Polyester / Fabric Base: 100% Polyamide / Lining: 95% Polyamide, 5% Elastane. Made in Brazil. Hand wash, do not tumble dry or bleach. Dry flat in the shade. Do not iron or dryclean. VEC34683

items.name: NOEMI TWEED TOP
items.description: El Noemi Tweed Top destaca la estructura de la tela en una silueta femenina y delicadamente equipada. El estilo cuenta con un escote redondeado sutilmente, correas delgadas ajustables y paneles que contornan el busto, mientras que los parches florales aplicados y bordados se extienden orgánicamente a lo largo de la pieza, yendo más allá de los bordes de la parte superior para crear un efecto dimensional.
items.description_en: The Noemi Tweed Top highlights the structure of the fabric in a feminine and delicately fitted silhouette. The style features a subtly rounded neckline, adjustable thin straps, and panels that contour the bust, while appliquéd and embroidered floral patches organically extend throughout the piece, going beyond the edges of the top to create a dimensional effect. A metallic zipper at the back completes the design. Composition: 50% Polyester, 46% Cotton, 3% Metal, 1% Elastane / Lining: 87% Polyamide, 13% Elastane. Made in Brazil. Hand wash, do not bleach or tumble dry. Dry flat in the shade. Do not iron or dryclean. TOP34477

items.name: NOEMI TWEED MINI SKIRT
items.description: La Falda de Tejido Noemi combina la estructura clásica del tejido con un acabado artesanal delicado y femenino. El estilo cuenta con una cintura alta, silueta recta y corta duración, mientras que el borde está acentuado con parches florales aplicados y bordados que crean textura, dimensión y un efecto subtly tridimensional.
items.description_en: The Noemi Tweed Mini Skirt combines the classic structure of the fabric with a delicate and feminine artisanal finish. The style features a high waist, straight silhouette, and short length, while the hem is accented with appliquéd and embroidered floral patches that create texture, dimension, and a subtly three-dimensional effect. The appliqués organically extend beyond the hem, adding movement and visual richness. An invisible zipper at the back completes the design. Composition: 50% Polyester, 46% Cotton, 3% Metal, 1% Elastane / Lining: 87% Polyamide, 13% Elastane. Made in Brazil. Hand wash, do not bleach or tumble dry. Dry flat in the shade. Do not iron or dryclean. SAC34479

items.name: LUMA JACQUARD PEPLUM MINI DRESS
items.description: El Luma Jacquard Peplum Mini Vestido equilibra la estructura y la feminidad en una silueta llamativa. El diseño cuenta con un busto estructurado con un corte central, una corbata de cuello de alto, y un corte metálico de declaración en el centro del escote, creando un punto focal.
items.description_en: The Luma Jacquard Peplum Mini Dress balances structure and femininity in a striking silhouette. The design features a structured bust with a center cutout, a halter neck tie, and a statement metallic trim at the center of the neckline, creating a focal point. The short skirt features pronounced volume at the hem, with a gathered panel that creates a subtly flared effect and adds movement to the look. An invisible zipper at the back provides a discreet finish. Composition: 90% Polyester, 10% Metallic Fiber / Lining: 95% Polyester, 5% Elastane. Made in Brazil. Hand wash, do not bleach or tumble dry. Dry flat in the shade. Do not iron or dryclean. VEC34511

items.name: CANDY LINEN MINI DRESS
items.description: Este vestido Candy Linen Mini cuenta con un escote corazón con un perfil de ganchillo y detalle a lo largo de la cintura, un corte de aberturas y una falda atada completa con ganchillo adicional a lo largo de la línea de hemline. Cierre de la espalda Zipper.
items.description_en: This Candy Linen Mini Dress features a sweetheart neckline with a crochet outline and detail along the waist, a keyhole cutout and a full tiered skirt with additional crochet along the hemline. Zipper back closure. Made in Brazil. 68% Viscose 28% Linen 4% Other Fibers. VEC30756US

items.name: SILK PLISSE FLUTTER MINI DRESS
items.description: Este mini vestido compuesto por chiffon y tulle cuenta con un escote de V plunging con un detalle a lo largo de las correas, el detalle de rotura a lo largo y el brillo adicional a lo largo de la hemlinea.
items.description_en: This mini dress composed of chiffon and tulle features a plunging V neckline with a flutter detail along the straps, ruching detail throughout and additional flutter along the hemline. Back zipper closure. Made in Brazil. Mesh 95% Polyamide 5% Elastane Sheer Poly 100% Polyester. VEC30935US

items.name: RADIANT JERSEY HALTERNECK GOWN
items.description: Esta bata cuenta con un escote de alto voluminoso con detalles ruching a lo largo de la cintura y centro de hardware especial en una falda de longitud completa fluida. Diseño de espalda abierto con una corbata en el cuello y cierre de cremallera oculta.
items.description_en: This gown features a plunging halter neckline with ruching detail along the waistline and center special hardware into a flowy full length skirt. Open back design with a tie at the neck and concealed zipper closure. Made in Brazil. 95% Polyester 5% Elastane. VEL31703.

items.name: JOY LACE MIDI DRESS
items.description: Este delicado vestido de midi trae un toque de encanto artesanal a las noches de verano. Hecho con sutil bordado floral, cuenta con una silueta favorecedora con un corpiño ajustado, correas delgadas y un dobladillo suavemente acampanado.
items.description_en: This delicate midi dress brings a touch of handcrafted charm to summer evenings. Made with subtle floral embroidery, it features a flattering silhouette with a fitted bodice, thin straps, and a softly flared hem. The 3D floral appliqués add dimension and femininity, creating an artisanal look that’s both romantic and refined. Perfect for a sunset dinner by the beach or an elegant stroll through the streets of Ipanema. Made in Brazil. 50% Cotton. 50% Polyester. VEM32450

items.name: AMARYLLIS EMBROIDERED MINI DRESS
items.description: Femenino y atemporal, este pequeño vestido de manga larga cuenta con un vibrante bordado floral sobre encaje de encaje, con una cintura definida y falda suave para una silueta favorecedora. Un profundo escote en V añade un toque de aure, mientras que el forro 100% algodón garantiza una comodidad transpirable.
items.description_en: Feminine and timeless, this long-sleeve mini dress features vibrant floral embroidery over sheer lace, with a defined waist and softly flared skirt for a flattering silhouette. A deep V-neckline adds a touch of allure, while the 100% cotton lining ensures breathable comfort. Perfect for garden parties, celebrations, or any special occasion. Made in Brazil. 100% Polyester. VEC32331

items.name: BRUMA MIDI DRESS
items.description: Elegante y romántico, este vestido de midi presenta apliques florales esculpidos en el escote con tirantes delicados que se conectan en la parte delantera y envuelven alrededor del cuello, creando una silueta de estilo halter. El corpiño estructurado y falda suavemente acampanada ofrecen una forma favorecedora y femenina, perfecta para ocasiones especiales o momentos de novia modernos.
items.description_en: Elegant and romantic, this midi dress features sculpted floral appliqués at the neckline with delicate straps that connect at the front and wrap around the neck, creating a halter-style silhouette. The structured bodice and softly flared skirt offer a flattering, feminine shape—perfect for special occasions or modern bridal moments. Made in Brazil. 98% Cotton 2% Elastane. VEM32388

items.name: TROPIC LINEN FLOWER MINI DRESS
items.description: Una pieza destacada que combina la estructura y la suavidad, este mini vestido se define por su audaz appliqué floral en 3D en el corpiño, hecho a mano para un toque de elegancia artesanal. La parte superior ajustada contrasta hermosamente con la falda acampanada, creando una silueta favorecedora que se mueve con facilidad.
items.description_en: A standout piece that blends structure and softness, this mini dress is defined by its bold 3D floral appliqué at the bodice—handcrafted for a touch of artisanal elegance. The fitted top contrasts beautifully with the flared skirt, creating a flattering silhouette that moves with ease. Feminine and fresh, it's the kind of dress made for sunset cocktails or celebrating summer by the sea. Made in Brazil. 55% Linen. 45% Viscose. VEC32380

items.name: TROPIC LINEN MIDI DRESS
items.description: Una visión de elegancia y delicada artesanía, este mini vestido de marfil trae el encanto de las floraciones de verano a la vida. Adorado con apliques florales a mano, cada pétalo bordado intrincadamente añade dimensión y estilo artesanal a la silueta de caza de figuras.
items.description_en: A vision of elegance and delicate craftsmanship, this ivory mini dress brings the charm of summer blooms to life. Adorned with hand-applied floral appliqués, each intricately embroidered petal adds dimension and artisanal flair to the figure-hugging silhouette. Ideal for a sunset cocktail at a rooftop bar in Leblon or a garden party by the sea, this piece channels the lightness and romance of a Rio de Janeiro summer. Made in Brazil. 55% Linen. 45% Viscose. VEM32374

items.name: PAPILLON JACQUARD FLUTTER MINI DRESS
items.description: Este mini vestido está hecho de jacquard estirado con un corpiño ajustado y un diseño a lo largo del escote cuadrado y la hemlina. Cierre con cremallera trasera ajustada.

items.description: Delicado y femenino, este mini vestido blanco cuenta con un corpiño de encaje ahumado con un escote y tirantes suaves de cinta. La falda entallada está terminada con encaje ondulado detallando, añadiendo textura y movimiento románticos—perfecto para eventos de novia, celebraciones de verano, o una mirada coqueta.
items.description_en: Delicate and feminine, this white mini dress features a smocked lace bodice with a sweetheart neckline and soft ribbon straps. The flared skirt is finished with scalloped lace detailing, adding romantic texture and movement—perfect for bridal events, summer celebrations, or a flirty getaway look. Made in Brazil. 100% Cotton. VEC32480

items.name: NATURAL CROCHET DRESS
items.description: Este vestido cuenta con un escote corazón con detalles de corte lateral favorecedor y un diseño completo de ganchillo. Retroceda abierta con detalle rouching, correas ajustables y un cierre de cremallera trasero oculto.

items.name: DELICATA FLUTTER MAXI DRESS
items.description: Romántico y etéreo, el Gown Floral Delicata está adornado con el exclusivo motivo de Delicata en azul suave. Cuenta con mangas largas, delicados detallamientos de rifa y encaje que traen un encanto de inspiración vintage.
items.description_en: Romantic and ethereal, the Delicata Floral Gown is adorned with the exclusive Delicata motif in soft blue. It features long sleeves, delicate ruffle detailing, and lace trim that bring a vintage-inspired charm. The defined waistline and floor-length pleated skirt create a flowing, feminine silhouette. Finished with a concealed back zipper closure. Made in China. Model wears size 4. VEL32457

items.name: AURA LACE FLUTTER MIDI DRESS
items.description: Este vestido de midi cuenta con nuestro tejido Aura Lace con una prenda de estilo bustier y corpiño ajustado en una falda en forma de fundición con una línea de encaje capa. Tirantes gruesos, y un cierre de cremallera trasero expuesto.
items.description_en: This midi dress features our Aura Lace fabric with a bustier style top and fitted bodice into a flutter shaped skirt with a layered hemline of lace. Thin straps, and an exposed back zipper closure. Made in China. 100% Polyester. VEM31352.

items.name: BOTANIC RETRO MINI DRESS
items.description: El Vestido Botánico Retro Mini es la mezcla perfecta de comodidad y encanto. Hecho de un tejido texturado con un estiramiento suave, abraza el cuerpo con un ajuste favorecedor.
items.description_en: The Botanic Retro Mini Dress is the perfect blend of comfort and charm. Made from a textured fabric with a soft stretch, it hugs the body with a flattering fit. The botanical print evokes the lush nature of a summer in Rio, while the ruffled hem adds playful movement. A rope belt with tassel details cinches the waist for a relaxed yet feminine silhouette. Whether you're strolling along Ipanema or heading to a sunny brunch, this dress brings effortless elegance to any warm-weather occasion. Made in Brazil. 100% Cotton. VEC32295

items.name: ALICIA TULLE MAXI DRESS
items.description: El vestido Alicia Tulle Maxi combina brillo, transparencia y movimiento en una silueta llamativa. El estilo cuenta con un escote frontal profundo, mangas voluminosas largas y cortes laterales de la cintura, junto con una espalda dramáticamente abierta terminada con un botón en el escote.
items.description_en: The Alicia Tulle Maxi Dress combines shine, transparency, and movement in a striking silhouette. The style features a deep front neckline, long voluminous sleeves, and side waist cutouts, along with a dramatically open back finished with a button at the neckline. Gathering creates volume around the waist and hips, where fringe appliqués enhance the movement of the piece, while a second fringe detail follows the asymmetrical hem. An invisible zipper at the back completes the design. Made in Brazil. 81% Polyamide, 19% Metallic Fringes (100% Polyester). Hand wash. Do not bleach. Do not tumble dry. Do not dry clean. VEL34659

items.name: BIANCA LACE DEEP V GOWN
items.description: El Bianca Lace Deep V Gown está elaborado íntegramente en encaje floral sobre una capa de desnudos. Cuenta con un escote de alto voluminoso con bordes de encaje rizado y una espalda abierta para una silueta impresionante.
items.description_en: The Bianca Lace Deep V Gown is crafted entirely in sheer floral lace over a nude underlay. It features a plunging halter neckline with ruffled lace trim and an open back for a sultry, striking silhouette. The dramatic asymmetrical hem is finished with cascading ruffled lace panels and a thigh-high front slit, creating movement throughout the floor-length skirt. Made in Brazil. 100% polyamide. Hand wash, do not bleach or tumble dry. Do not dryclean or iron. VEL34593

items.name: THEREZA TULLE HALTER MAXI DRESS
items.description: El vestido Thereza Tulle Halter Maxi cuenta con recortes estratégicos para crear una elegante silueta con fuerte impacto visual. El estilo cuenta con un escote alto en la parte delantera, aberturas de la cintura ancha, y una espalda totalmente abierta terminada con un botón cubierto en el escote.
items.description_en: The Thereza Tulle Halter Maxi Dress features strategic cutouts to create an elegant silhouette with strong visual impact. The style features a high neckline at the front, wide side waist openings, and a fully open back finished with a covered button at the neckline. The bodice meets the long skirt at a central gathered point, while the wide, fluid lower portion adds lightness and movement. An invisible zipper at the back completes the design. Composition: 65% Recycled Polyamide, 21% Polyamide, 11% Metallic Thread, 3% Elastane / Lining: 95% Polyamide, 5% Elastane. Made in Brazil. Hand wash, do not bleach or tumble dry. Drip dry flat in the shade. Do not iron or dryclean. VEL34531

items.name: RUTH TULLE MIDI DRESS
items.description: El Ruth Tulle Midi Dress combina una silueta esculpida con detalles intrincados y sofisticación femenina. Elaborado a partir de la tul de estiramiento, el diseño cuenta con un escote cuadrado y mangas largas, ambas definidas por un delicado ruching que crea textura y dimensión.
items.description_en: The Ruth Tulle Midi Dress combines a sculpted silhouette with intricate detailing and feminine sophistication. Crafted from stretch tulle, the design features a square neckline and long, fitted sleeves, both defined by delicate ruching that creates texture and dimension. Exquisite beaded appliqués are scattered throughout the silhouette, adding a subtle touch of sparkle and artisanal detail. The fitted midi silhouette is enhanced by gathered ruching that contours the body and continues along the skirt, creating a fluid, sculptural effect. A low square back and concealed back closure complete the design. Composition: 96% Polyester, 4% Elastane. Made in Brazil. Hand wash, do not bleach or tumble dry. Dry flat in the shade. Do not iron or dryclean. VEM34537

items.name: NOEMI TWEED MINI DRESS
items.description: El Noemi Tweed Mini Dress combina la estructura de la tela con un acabado femenino y ricamente elaborado. El estilo cuenta con tirantes anchos, un busto estructurado y una silueta equipada, mientras que los parches florales aplicados y bordados a lo largo del escote añaden textura, dimensión y un brillo artesano delicado.
items.description_en: The Noemi Tweed Mini Dress combines the structure of the fabric with a feminine and richly crafted finish. The style features wide straps, a structured bust, and a fitted silhouette, while appliquéd and embroidered floral patches along the neckline add texture, dimension, and a delicate artisanal shine. The short skirt is finished with a wide, structured double ruffle that creates volume and movement, reinforcing the feminine silhouette. An invisible zipper at the back completes the design. Composition: 50% Polyester, 46% Cotton, 3% Metal, 1% Elastane / Lining: 87% Polyamide, 13% Elastane. Made in Brazil. Hand wash, do not bleach or tumble dry. Dry flat in the shade. Do not iron or dryclean. VEC34476

items.name: LEONE MINI DRESS
items.description: El vestido Leone Mini cuenta con un corpiño de bustier ajustado y sin tirantes en crepe suave, contrastado con una falda atada de bisagras brillantes que añade textura, brillo y movimiento. El timón de capa crea una silueta juguetona y coqueta perfecta para la noche.
items.description_en: The Leone Mini Dress features a fitted, strapless bustier bodice in smooth crepe, contrasted with a tiered skirt of glittering fringe that adds texture, shine, and movement. The layered hem creates a playful, flirty silhouette perfect for evening. Made in Brazil. 100% Viscose. Hand wash, do not bleach or tumble dry. Do not iron or dryclean. VEC34649 Please note: Belt is not included and is shown for styling purposes only.

items.description_en: The Leone Top is crafted in rich viscose with a halter neckline that ties into a draped, fringe-trimmed scarf detail at the neck. The cropped, backless silhouette is finished with a button closure at the nape and a back zipper for a sleek, structured fit. Made in Brazil. 100% Viscose. Hand wash, do not bleach or tumble dry. Do not iron or dryclean. TOP33768

The floor-grazing hem and fluid drape create a striking, statement-making finish that pairs seamlessly with the coordinating blazer. Made in Brazil. 100% Viscose . Hand wash, do not tumble dry or bleach. Do not dryclean or iron. SAM33769

Made in Brazil. 100% Viscose. Hand wash, do not bleach or tumble dry. Do not iron or dryclean. BLA33772

items.name: ALICIA TULLE TOP
items.description: La Alicia Tulle Top encarna un glamour sin esfuerzo en una silueta sin mangas. Elaborada a partir de tul de punto brillante, este estilo cuenta con un escote recto y un borde de fringe que rastrea el borde, agregando movimiento y textura al diseño.

A keyhole back closure completes the look with a refined finish. Made in Brazil. 81% Polyamide, 19% Metallic Fringes (100% Polyester). Hand wash. Do not bleach. Do not tumble dry. Do not dry clean. items.name: Arai One Piece Azure Floral Stripes
items.description: La pieza Arai es una silueta completamente chic y favorecedora esta temporada! Similar a nuestra Michelle, mantiene la icónica estética Silvia Tcherassi con un hermoso juego en rayas, escalas y patrones, pero en nuestro nuevo estampado floral azul rayado.
items.description_en: The Arai one piece is an absolutely chic and flattering new silhouette this season! Similar to our Michelle, it maintains the iconic Silvia Tcherassi aesthetic with a lovely play on stripes, scales and patterns, but in our new azure floral striped print. The material is a thick lycra and the fabric is placed in the most flattering way to create a figure favoring cross halter neck silhouette! The one piece feature trendy cut outs and an open back. items.description_en: A house favorite! Our continued collaboration with the master shoemaker Gia Borghini featured in the most refined selection for Resort 2023! Our Dalila heels in our classic soft Italian calf leather. A timeless and versatile staple for the Silvia Tcherassi Resort collection. They feature a quilted toe-thong style and crisscross straps below that can be tied at the ankle. It is a very well-supported and comfortable shoe that gives stability to one's foot. In a classy navy hue that lends itself to be color-blocked or used to add a pop of color, this style can take you from season to season. Available in multiple colorways.

items.description_en: A well-made high-heeled sandal in quality leather is on our wishlist season after season. For Fall 2023, the Golda heels come in a variety of options ranging from a stunning red shade to a seasonless camel tone, as well as two statement metallic options for nighttime glamour. Part of our continued partnership with Italian house, Gia Borghini, these wrap-around sandals stand out thanks to their timeless, yet fashion forward appeal. Like all of our shoes, they deliver style without sacrificing comfort. Please allow between 1-2 weeks for your order to ship.

items.description_en: Available in solid yellow georgette fabric as well as in our cyprus print jersey option, this blouse features a single long, billowing sleeve. Ruching throughout the side provides a close fit to the body.

items.name: Nahia Top
items.description: Esta temporada, algunas de nuestras piezas más comentadas cuentan con lentejuelas sobre las impresiones. La crop top Nahia viene en dos opciones y cuenta con un escote de cierre que se conecta al cuello y una cremallera de oro expuesta de la parte posterior.
items.description_en: This season, some of our most talked-about pieces feature sequins over prints. The Nahia crop top comes in two options and features a halter neckline that ties at the neck and an exposed gold zipper from the back. We love the sparkle factor and overall feel of this piece. This piece has a coordinating item.

items.name: Khandi Top Camel Navy Stripes
items.description: Un estilo femenino y femenino para la temporada! Es una Silvia Tcherassi tomar una clásica parte superior con un juego en patrones geométricos, formas y recortes.
items.description_en: A dainty and feminine cropped style for the season! It's a Silvia Tcherassi take on a classic cropped top with a play on geometric patterns, shapes, and cutouts. This top features an overlapped v neck shape at the bust area and two thin straps. The key is in the details with off-the-shoulder sleeves and the various directions that the camel and navy stripes are placed in to create a flattering shape for all. The Khandi top has an exposed zipper at the center back for closure and to hold in place. An easy selection to elevate your look.

items.name: Kayla Top Green Abstract
items.description: Un estilo cropped de alta moda, con un hermoso tono. La parte superior de Kayla tiene correas juguetonas que van sobre los hombros y ayunan detrás del cuello.
items.description_en: A high fashion cropped style, with a beautiful hue. The Kayla top has playful straps that go over the shoulders and fasten behind the neck. The delicate silk piece is cut in our green abstract palm silk and appears delicate due to the dainty details it conveys. It's constructed with interlaced ties at center front designed to be pulled from the bottom up for desired coverage and for an adjustable gathered effect. The back features a stretchy ruched piece with a closing of an exposed gold separating zipper.

items.name: Marcel Blouse Golden Magenta Stripes
items.description: Un giro orientado al detalle en una camisa tradicional de botón hacia abajo, la blusa Marcel cuenta con elementos clásicos como un cuello de camisa escote y mangas largas, sin embargo el estilo cropped y un sutil nudo drapado en la cintura moderniza la blusa añadiendo dimensión para aplanar la figura. Cortar en nuestro tejido dorado magenta rayado, cuenta con el amor de la casa por unas pistas de juego y direcciones de contraste.
items.description_en: A detail-oriented twist on a traditional button down shirt, the Marcel blouse features classical elements such as a shirt collar neckline and long sleeves, yet the cropped style and a subtle draped knot at the waist modernizes the blouse while adding dimension to flatter the figure. Cut in our gold magenta striped fabric, it boasts the house's love for a play-on-stripes and contrasting directions. This Silvia Tcherassi special revisitation features a slightly tailored yet relaxed fit, concealed buttons down the front for closure, yet the magic is in the differentiating details. Timeless and seasonless.

items.name: Natasha Top Magenta Floral
items.description: Una pieza de declaración romántica y distinguida! La parte superior de Natasha es un bustier ajustado con rebote para una estructura elegante.
items.description_en: A romantic and distinguished statement piece! The Natasha top is a fitted cropped bustier with boning for a sleek structure. It is an off-the-shoulder selection with gathered fabric coming from the neckline and overlapping drapery covering the arms. The sleeves can be regulated to the volume of one's liking and have enough space to move around in! They create a v-shaped effect on the silhouette for a streamlined look and at the back, a zipper for closure is incorporated. Cut in a novelty textured magenta floral jacquard, it makes for an elegant and feminine appeal.

items.name: Eva Dress Fuchsia Lime Stripes
items.description: Canalizar todas las cosas brillantes y coloridas con este número de Primavera 2023, el vestido Eva. Cortar de una tela de viscosa de fuschia y lima rayada que cae suavemente sobre el cuerpo con un ajuste favorable, la impresión se coloca asimétricamente en todo el vestido con un enfoque pintoresco.
items.description_en: Channel all things bright and colorful with this Spring 2023 number, the Eva dress. Cut from a fuschia and lime striped viscose fabric that falls softly over the body with a favorable fit, the print is placed asymmetrically throughout the dress with a painterly approach. It is further elevated with the refreshing silhouette featuring a v-neckline, thin shoulder straps, a cinched waist, a long skirt lined with organza for durability and to hold its shape. A drop-skirt with a flare effect that effortlessly creates a chic floor-length ensemble.

items.description: Fabricado en satinado martillado, este versátil y elegante trouser se sienta alto en la cintura y cuenta con una bengala de gran tamaño. Desde atrás, una cremallera oculta proporciona un ajuste hermoso y sin costuras.
items.description_en: Crafted in hammered satin, this versatile and elegant trouser sits high at the waist and features a wide-legged flare. From behind, a concealed zipper provides a beautiful, seamless fit. This piece has a coordinating item.

items.name: Marco Heel Yellow
items.description: ¡Un nuevo favorito! Nuestra continua colaboración con el maestro zapatero Gia Borghini apareció en la selección más refinada para la primavera 2023.
items.description_en: A new favorite! Our continued collaboration with the master shoemaker Gia Borghini featured in the most refined selection for Spring 2023. Meet our Marco heel in soft Italian calf leather which is a timeless and versatile staple for the Silvia Tcherassi collection. The sandals feature a toe-loop modern and trendy style and crisscross straps that can be tied at the ankle. It is a very well-supported and comfortable shoe that gives stability to one's foot. In a stunning yellow hue that lends itself to be color blocked or used to add a pop of color, this style can take you from season to season.

items.name: Irene Belt Olive
items.description: Un matrimonio de los materiales más de alta calidad, el cinturón de Irene de la temporada está elaborado con cuero italiano de alta calidad y una impresionante hebilla de resina ovalada que está disponible en varios tonos. Las formaciones de roca natural fueron una parte importante de la inspiración detrás de esta colección y estos exquisitos accesorios capturan adecuadamente la sensación general de otoño 2023.
items.description_en: A marriage of the most high-quality materials, the season’s Irene belt is crafted with high quality Italian leather and a stunning oval resin buckle that is available in various shades. Natural rock formations were a big part of the inspiration behind this collection and these exquisite accessories adequately capture the overall feel of Fall 2023. Besides elevating a look, these pieces also define the figure effortlessly. We love it cinched around a tailored blazer or with wide-legged trousers.

items.name: Andie Pant Gray
items.description: El pantalón favorito de todos está de vuelta esta temporada. Disponible en varias opciones impresas, el Andie es un elemento de alta resistencia favorecedor que al instante alarga la figura.
items.description_en: Everyone’s favorite pant is back this season. Available in several printed options, the Andie is a flattering high-waisted essential that instantly elongates the figure. The wide legs and high-waisted fit that discreetly zips from the back, creating a totally seamless fit from the front make them a hit season after season. We absolutely adore a head-to-toe look, but also love them paired with a body-hugging bodysuit, a tailored blazer or even a casual tee.

items.name: Dora Belt Pastel Yellow
items.description: El cinturón Dora es un hermoso cinturón de declaración de Silvia Tcherassi Spring 2023 Collection! Está hecho en un color amarillo pastel neutro con una piedra rectangular en el mismo tono.
items.description_en: The Dora Belt is a beautiful statement belt from Silvia Tcherassi Spring 2023 Collection! It’s made in a neutral pastel yellow colored leather with a rectangular stone in the same hue. It’s the perfect accessory for elevating a look and giving it a fun touch!

items.name: Peggie Dress Marigold
items.description: Este vestido Silvia Tcherassi Resort 2023, enmarcado por manguitos de manguito, es un diseño icónico. A partir de nuestro toque de marigold, el midi Peggie está elaborado en algodón ligero.
items.description_en: Framed by puff sleeves, this Silvia Tcherassi Resort 2023 dress is an iconic design. From our marigold hue, the Peggie midi is crafted in lightweight cotton. Showcasing a cut-out at the sides that extend to the back waist, this gathered style flows into a tiered hem and features a portrait neck, billowing elbow-length sleeves, elasticized cuffs, a back zip closures, and an overall romantic effect! Perfect for any afternoon event or for packing it away to take on vacation.

items.name: Charlize Dress Crimson Jacquard
items.description: Este hermoso vestido de Charlize se corta en la tela más fina de crimson jacquard. Effortlessly elegante con su diseño elegante que cuenta con mangas largas, un escote en forma de v, un tapiz delantero centro de aberturas, una silueta ajustada, una falda con una abertura de borde alto y una cómoda cremallera invisible trasera.
items.description_en: This beautiful Charlize dress is cut in the finest crimson jacquard fabric. Effortlessly elegant with its chic design that features long sleeves, a v-shaped neckline, a keyhole center front cutout, a slim-fit silhouette, a flared skirt with a high-low hem opening and a comfortable back invisible zipper.

A true labor of love, the multi-layered fringe detailing in a stunning degrade effect further stands out with movement, showing glimpses of the intricate lace base that lies beneath them. An open back delivers the same dramatic effect from all angles. A gown for a very special event.

items.description_en: A classic trouser silhouette in three eye-catching options: embroidered cotton, a wool-lurex blend and black jacquard, the Orion is the pant of the season. A straight leg and cropped cut allow for them to be paired with anything from flat gladiator sandals, ballerinas, stilettos and even our statement leather booties. Pockets make them functional and a flattering high-waisted print in sophisticated material make it a solid go-to for women of all ages.

In a bright orange hue that lends itself to be color-blocked or used to add a pop of color, this style can take you from season to season. Available in multiple colorways.

items.name: Irene Belt Terracota
items.description: Un matrimonio de los materiales más de alta calidad, el cinturón de Irene de la temporada está elaborado con cuero italiano de alta calidad y una impresionante hebilla de resina ovalada que está disponible en varios tonos. Las formaciones de roca natural fueron una parte importante de la inspiración detrás de esta colección y estos exquisitos accesorios capturan adecuadamente la sensación general de otoño 2023.
items.description_en: A marriage of the most high-quality materials, the season’s Irene belt is crafted with high quality Italian leather and a stunning oval resin buckle that is available in various shades. Natural rock formations were a big part of the inspiration behind this collection and these exquisite accessories adequately capture the overall feel of Fall 2023. Besides elevating a look, these pieces also define the figure effortlessly. We love it cinched around a tailored blazer or with wide-legged trousers.

items.name: Magnolia Skirt Golden Magenta Stripes
items.description: La impresionante Magnolia es una falda de longitud maxi con nuestra icónica Silvia Tcherassi play-on-stripes, cortada en nuestras tiras magenta doradas de algodón. Cuenta con detalles intrincados con una zona de cadera equipada que se sumerge en una silueta a línea con botones rojos expuestos en todo el frente central.
items.description_en: The stunning Magnolia is a maxi length skirt with our iconic Silvia Tcherassi play-on-stripes, cut in our cotton golden magenta stripes. It features intricate details with a fitted hip area that flares into an a-line silhouette with exposed red buttons across the center front. The romantic skirt has an array of multi directional lines that makes this piece interesting and particularly unique. It comes with belt loops and a detachable ruched belt cut from the same fabric and with a red resin buckle.

items.name: Casey Pant Verde Lime
items.description: Nuestros pantalones de cintura alta son amados por su drape favorecedor en el cuerpo y su practicidad atemporal. El pantalón Casey de la colección se sienta en la cintura alta con un detalle de reunión frontal central y centro de vuelta cremallera invisible para el cierre.
items.description_en: Our high-waisted trousers are beloved for their flattering drape on the body and their timeless practicality. The collection’s Casey pant sits at the high waist with a center front gathering detail and center back invisible zipper for closure. Flaring out to the sides, this piece features an elongating effect. It is cut from luxurious jacquard fabric with a subtle abstract motif throughout and crafted in a stunning verde lime hue that makes for a lively piece. It also has a coordinating item top and can truly elevate one's look. Chic and filled with unique details.

items.name: Salome Dress Navy
items.description: La casa ha experimentado durante mucho tiempo con detalles de franja y esta temporada, hacen un regreso gracias a su hermosa colocación atada en tonos preciosos, como el profundo tono marino del vestido de Salome. Cortar en una silueta sin tirantes con una malla nuda, apenas perceptible alrededor del escote y la espalda, este número cuenta con una base de encaje, tulle y lentejuela detallado.
items.description_en: The house has long experimented with fringe details and this season, they make a comeback thanks to their beautiful, tiered placement in gorgeous shades, such as the deep navy hue of the Salome dress. Cut in a strapless silhouette with a nude, barely perceptible mesh around the neckline and back, this number features a lace base, tulle and sequin detailing. A dress meant to dance in.

items.name: Capri Terry Fuchsia Bag
items.description: Añadir un toque de color y estilo único a tu aspecto con esta bolsa estructurada de terrycloth-textured, una pieza llamativa que combina moda, frescura y funcionalidad. Su vibrante hue fucsia trae energía y personalidad, mientras que el borde rosa y azul eleva el diseño con un contraste moderno y elegante. Incluye una bufanda impresa en tonos rosados que añade un acabado elegante y femenino, así como un encantador encanto en forma de perro que le da un toque divertido y distintivo.
items.description_en: Add a touch of color and unique style to your looks with this structured terrycloth-textured bag, a striking piece that combines fashion, freshness, and functionality. Its vibrant fuchsia hue brings energy and personality, while the pink and blue trim elevates the design with a modern and chic contrast. It includes a printed scarf in pink tones that adds an elegant and feminine finish, as well as a charming dog-shaped charm that gives it a fun and distinctive twist.

items.name: Trinidad  White Bikini Bottom
items.description: Bikini de ganchillo en tono negro y blanco con bordado de martillo en las tazas en tono camello. Las correas están decoradas con encantos de estrellas doradas, ideales para un look de playa único. Producido en una fábrica sostenible y hecho a mano por artesanos peruanos.
items.description_en: Crochet bikini in black and white tone with starfish embroidery on the cups in camel tone. The straps are decorated with golden star charms, ideal for a unique beach look. Produced in a sustainable factory and handmade by Peruvian artisans.

items.name: Missy Light Blue Bikini Bottom
items.description: Missy Light Blue destaca con delicado trabajo de ganchillo que combina dos tonos de azul. Con flores tejidas y correas de corbata en la parte superior e inferior, se ajusta a su tamaño. Fabricado a mano en Perú por artesanos en una fábrica sostenible.
items.description_en: Missy Light Blue stands out with delicate crochet work combining two shades of blue. With woven flowers and tie-able straps at the top and bottom, it adjusts to your size. Handmade in Peru by artisans in a sustainable factory.

items.name: Missy Flowers Light Blue Bikini Bottom
items.description: Ligero fondo bikini azul con detalles delicados de ganchillo blanco y appliqués de flores tejidos. Las correas ajustables del lado de la corbata permiten un ajuste personalizado, creando un aspecto femenino y artesanal.
items.description_en: Light blue bikini bottom featuring delicate white crochet details and woven flower appliqués. Adjustable tie-side straps allow for a personalized fit, creating a feminine and artisanal look.

items.name: Missy Flowers Light Blue Bikini Top
items.description: Ligero bikini azul superior con detalles delicados de ganchillo blanco y apliques de flores tejidos. Las correas de corbata ajustables permiten un ajuste personalizado, creando un aspecto femenino y artesanal.
items.description_en: Light blue bikini top featuring delicate white crochet details and woven flower appliqués. Adjustable tie straps allow for a personalized fit, creating a feminine and artisanal look.

items.name: Isabel Burgundy Dress
items.description: El ajuste perfecto, hecho en un vestido. El vestido Isabel Denim es un estilo denim sin mangas atemporal, con una silueta y longitud midi. Una abertura lateral añade movimiento y un toque moderno, lo que lo convierte en una pieza sin esfuerzo versátil para cualquier ocasión.
items.description_en: The perfect fit, made into a dress. The Isabel Denim Dress is a timeless sleeveless denim style, featuring a fitted silhouette and midi length. A side slit adds movement and a modern touch, making it an effortlessly versatile piece for any occasion.

items.name: Peggy Black Silver Bikini Bottom
items.description: ¡Pon tu bronceado con Peggy! ¡En el tejido plata más brillante que atrapará el ojo de todos! Producido en una fábrica sostenible y hecho a mano por artesanos peruanos.
items.description_en: Get your tan on with Peggy! In the most stunning shiny silver fabric that will catch everyone's eye! Produced in a sustainable factory and handmade by Peruvian artisans.

items.name: Tiana Polka Dots Skirt
items.description: Falda con una impresión de lunares blanco y negro y detalles delicados de encaje que añaden un toque femenino y sofisticado. Su diseño atemporal es perfecto para emparejar con la parte superior o crear diferentes looks.
items.description_en: Skirt with a black-and-white polka dot print and delicate lace details that add a feminine and sophisticated touch. Its timeless design is perfect for pairing with the matching top or creating different looks.

items.name: Tiana Polka Dots Top
items.description: Blouse con una impresión de lunares blanco y negro, botones frontales y delicados detalles de encaje a lo largo de las mangas y el dobladillo inferior. Su diseño femenino y atemporal es perfecto para crear looks sofisticados.
items.description_en: Blouse with a black-and-white polka dot print, front buttons, and delicate lace details along the sleeve hems and bottom hem. Its feminine and timeless design is perfect for creating sophisticated looks.

items.name: Isabel Denim Dress
items.description: El ajuste perfecto en forma de vestido: un clásico vestido denim sin mangas con una abertura lateral.

items.name: Uchi Pearl Dress
items.description: El vestido Uchi Pearls es un vestido maxi equipado con un escote profundo y la corbata del cuello. Sus flores en 3D son aplicadas a lo largo de la prenda y cuentan con centros de gota como cristal que añaden textura, brillo y un acabado artesanal único. Elegante y sofisticado, está diseñado para ocasiones especiales.
items.description_en: The Uchi Pearls Dress is a fitted maxi dress with a deep neckline and halter neck tie. Its 3D flowers are appliquéd throughout the garment and feature crystal-like drop centers that add texture, shine, and a unique artisanal finish. Elegant and sophisticated, it is designed for special occasions.

items.name: Sisa Blue Skirt
items.description: Un conjunto fresco y femenino que combina estilo y comodidad en un aspecto sin esfuerzo. Su diseño de punto dotado por onda añade una sensación moderna y veraniega, perfecta para hacer una declaración en cualquier ocasión casual. La mini falda de alta cintura aplana la silueta y crea un aspecto armonioso cuando se usa como un conjunto.
items.description_en: A fresh and feminine set that combines style and comfort in one effortless look. Its wave-patterned knit design adds a modern, summery feel, perfect for making a statement on any casual occasion. The high-waisted mini skirt flatters the silhouette and creates a harmonious look when worn as a set.

items.name: Sisa Blue Top
items.description: Top sin mangas con detalles delicados de corbata frontal que permiten un ajuste ajustable al tiempo que agrega un toque sutilmente romántico. La mini falda de alta cintura aplana la silueta y crea un aspecto armonioso cuando se usa como un conjunto.
items.description_en: Sleeveless top featuring delicate front tie details that allow for an adjustable fit while adding a subtly romantic touch. The high-waisted mini skirt flatters the silhouette and creates a harmonious look when worn as a set.

items.name: Polly Retro Pink Dress

items.name: Mila Blue Maxi Dress
items.description: El Mila Blue es un vestido largo de punto con rayas en tonos de azul y crema. Su silueta equipada aplana la figura con un estilo fresco, femenino y elegante. Perfecto para el verano.

Tie the Sarong around your waist for added coverage, or style it as a dress-like cover up by tying the edges around your neck and back. Adjustable front ties finished with gold-plated details and a back button closure complete the look. Style the Nayana Long Dress with sandals and ViX accessories for a resort-ready look. Con una cintura elástica estándar y el logotipo de ViX firma en la parte posterior, ofrece un ajuste suave y sin costuras para la comodidad de todo el día, lo que lo hace todo menos básico.
items.description_en: From the ViX + Rosie Huntington-Whiteley collaboration, the Basic Bottom is your essential bikini bottom with a timeless, versatile design. Featuring a standard elastic waistband and the signature ViX logo at the back, it offers a smooth, seamless fit for all-day comfort, making it anything but basic. Style the Basic Bottom with a matching bikini top and cover up for a vacation-ready look. Features: Standard elastic waistband Striped lycra Fully lined ViX logo at the back Style# VF261094

items.name: Firenze Mia Lindsay Bottom - Valley
items.description: Desde la colaboración ViX + Rosie Huntington-Whiteley, el Firenze Mia Lindsay Bottom es una silueta contornilla giratoria diseñada para abrazar las caderas para un efecto favorecedor. Terminado con costuras de contraste en todo y un detalle dorado en la parte delantera, cuenta con una cintura ligeramente más amplia que el Bottom Básico para una mayor cobertura y comodidad.
items.description_en: From the ViX + Rosie Huntington-Whiteley collaboration, the Firenze Mia Lindsay Bottom is a body-contouring silhouette designed to hug the hips for a flattering, slimming effect. Finished with contrast stitching throughout and a gold-plated detail at the front, it features a slightly wider waistband than the Basic Bottom for added coverage and comfort. Style the Mia Lindsay Bottom with a matching bikini top and cover up for a vacation-ready look. Features: Slightly wider waistband than our standard Basic Bottom Fully lined ViX logo at back Exclusive crinkled lycra Gold-plated detail at front Style # VF261100

items.name: Firenze Mia Tri Top - Valley
items.description: Desde la colaboración ViX + Rosie Huntington-Whiteley, el Firenze Mia Tri Top es una toma inspirada en el clásico bikini triángulo. Diseñado con correas duales —un conjunto que se une en el cuello y otro conjunto de correas paralelas ajustables— está elaborado en nuestra exclusiva licra arrugada, terminada con un detalle de barra dorada en el busto y ajustable la espalda para un ajuste seguro.
items.description_en: From the ViX + Rosie Huntington-Whiteley collaboration, the Firenze Mia Tri Top is a sport-inspired take on the classic triangle bikini. Designed with dual straps — one set that ties at the neck and another set of adjustable parallel straps — it is crafted in our exclusive crinkled lycra, finished with a gold-plated bar detail at the bust and adjustable back ties for a secure fit. Style the Mia Tri Top with a matching bikini bottom and cover up for a vacation-ready look. Features: Sporty tri top Multiple straps Adjustable parallel shoulder straps Gold-plated detail at bust Tie closures at back Exclusive crinkled lycra Fully lined Removable padding Style # VF261096

items.name: Heaven Mayhem THE ICON WATCH
items.description: Este Icon Watch está diseñado para ser su elemento cotidiano y atemporal, combinando el encanto del diseño vintage con la funcionalidad moderna a un precio accesible. Elaborado con una auténtica correa de cuero negro, un oro de acero inoxidable o reloj plateado y mecanismo de cuarzo.
items.description_en: This Icon Watch is designed to be your everyday, timeless essential, combining the charm of vintage design with modern functionality at an accessible price point. Crafted with a genuine black leather strap, a stainless steel gold or silver-plated watch dial and quartz mechanism. The back of the watch features our signature handwritten engraving, adding a personal touch to this new classic. The Icon Watch is more than just an accessory; it’s a celebration of timeless, iconic women who inspire us. Each piece in this collection is a tribute to the elegance, strength, and grace that define iconic women through the ages. Please Note - the Icon Watch comes as a ready to wear product with the black strap attached. Our other strap options are sold separately as an addition.

items.description: Lentes de sol Rhey Oval - Sofisticación Streamlined elegancia con sólo el borde derecho. Rhey perfecciona el arte de la sofisticación sutil con su forma ovalada simplificada y ascensor suave en los rincones exteriores para una definición suave.
items.description_en: Rhey Oval Sunglasses - Streamlined Sophistication Streamlined elegance with just the right edge. Rhey perfects the art of subtle sophistication with its streamlined oval shape and soft lift at the outer corners for gentle definition. The streamlined oval silhouette with its subtle outer corner lift creates gentle eye definition without being overstated. Designed in Los Angeles and crafted from premium acetate with durable gold-tone triple-barrel hinges, Rhey delivers both sophisticated style and everyday comfort. The structured frame provides a secure, comfortable fit that won't slip or pinch, making them perfect for all-day wear from morning meetings to evening plans. This is understated sophistication at its finest—the kind of frames that elevate every look without trying too hard. Each pair includes a branded croc-embossed pouch and cleaning cloth for easy care on the go.

items.name: Heaven Mayhem BABY KNOT EARRINGS
items.description: Conozca las pendientes de nudo de bebé — una declaración escultórica en un tamaño más pequeño y usable. Diseñado con la silueta de nudo torcido firma de Heaven Mayhem, estos pendientes ofrecen un impacto audaz sin el peso.
items.description_en: Meet the Baby Knot Earrings — a sculptural statement in a smaller, wearable size. Designed with Heaven Mayhem’s signature twisted knot silhouette, these earrings deliver bold impact without the weight. Their hollow construction keeps them ultra-light, making them perfect for all-day wear, even for sensitive ears. Crafted in PVD-plated stainless steel, the Baby Knot Earrings resist tarnishing, scratching, and discoloration while remaining hypoallergenic and water-resistant for everyday wear. Whether you’re dressing up a tee or adding polish to an evening look, these earrings strike the balance between edgy and timeless. Minimal yet bold, the Baby Knot Earrings are the versatile statement piece you’ll keep in your daily rotation. Pair them solo for a clean look, or stack with other Heaven Mayhem designs to create a modern, layered effect. For pierced ears only.

A creative collaboration between Dita Von Teese and Heretic Parfum, it’s a scent fit for a sex siren, created with the eye of a visionary. A soft, red-lipped whisper with an all-consuming allure. HOW TO WEAR Our fragrances are gender-neutral and made for everyone. APPLICATION: Due to the inclusion of plant-based natural ingredients, our clean scents wear light and sheer. To increase staying power, you’ll want to apply the fragrance periodically throughout the day. LAYERING: We also encourage you to layer two to three Heretic fragrances not only to increase the overall intensity but to help you create your next signature scent. Choose heavy and lighter blends to layer together, spraying or dabbing the stronger scent first. View the “Layer With” section above for our perfumer’s recommendations.

items.name: DIRTY COCONUT ROLLERBALL
items.description: Esta obra maestra sensual basada en la planta combina la vainilla caliente, cosecha sostenible Sandalwood, y el coco cremoso para un afrodisíaco leñoso y exótico que relaja y calma. También disponible como un Eau de Parfum .
items.description_en: This plant-based sensual masterpiece melds warm Vanilla, sustainably harvested Sandalwood, and creamy Coconut for a woody, exotic aphrodisiac that relaxes and calms. Also available as an Eau de Parfum . TOP: Cedar, Vanillin (derived from clove) HEART: Coconut CO2 BASE: Sandalwood, Vanilla Absolute, Ambrettolide FRAGRANCE STORY Creamy coconut flesh blends with sustainably harvested sandalwood in this sensual masterpiece that strays far from 'basic beach' scents and the saccharine tanning lotions of yesteryear to dive deep into an elevated blend of sunbathed exotic woods and warmed vanilla. A sophisticated take on coconut perfume, Dirty Coconut uses coconut CO2 to achieve a more authentic expression of the fruit and to showcase its intensely tropical notes. By blending it with an 'ungodly' amount of rich sandalwood, they merge into a seductively milky fragrance that's both lusty and renewing. Packed with natural aphrodisiacs and stress-relieving ingredients, Dirty Coconut conjures swaying palms in the tropics, seaside relaxation, and forbidden island trysts. Dirty Coconut was inspired by the ultra-rare coco de mer palm tree and the suggestive, voluptuous proportions of its fruit. Leaving little to the imagination, the coco de mer fruit was first given the name Lodoicea Callipyge by early explorers, which means "beautiful buttocks" in Greek. Weighing in at around 25kg, it's the largest seed in the plant kingdom. This mysterious fruit has been ascribed with powerful healing properties, worshipped as a fertility symbol in its native Seychelles, and coveted as a prized object in the curiosity collections of nobility throughout history. Listen to our Dirty Coconut playlist: KELIA MONIZ Dirty Coconut is also inspired by the real-life ocean goddess and longboard pro-surfer Kelia Moniz . Being a superstar athlete in a male-dominated sport, we are in awe of how this Hawaiian Heretic not only reigns supreme over the toughest waves, but does so with fierce feminine confidence and grace. See more from our collaboration with Kelia on our blog . HOW TO WEAR Our fragrances are gender-neutral and made for everyone. APPLICATION: We use plant-based natural ingredients, which means our scents are light and sheer. To increase staying power, you’ll want to apply the fragrance periodically throughout the day. LAYERING: We also encourage you to layer two to three Heretic fragrances not only to increase the overall intensity but to help you create your next signature scent. Choose heavy and lighter blends to layer together, spraying or dabbing the stronger scent first. View the “Layer With” section above for our perfumer’s recommendations.

items.description: Esme captura la esencia del minimalismo de los 90 con un marco ovalado elegante que se siente fresco y moderno hoy en día.
items.description_en: Effortlessly chic, endlessly wearable. Esme captures the essence of 90s minimalism with a sleek oval frame that feels fresh and modern today. This is vintage-inspired eyewear done right—clean lines, perfect proportions, and that iconic oval silhouette that defined an era. The sleek oval shape flatters virtually every face while maintaining that coveted 90s minimalist aesthetic. Designed in Los Angeles and crafted from premium acetate with durable gold-tone triple-barrel hinges, Esme delivers both vintage style and contemporary comfort. The structured frame provides a secure, comfortable fit that won't slip or pinch, making them perfect for all-day wear whether you're running errands or meeting friends. Available in classic Black for modern edge or rich Tortoise for warm versatility. Each pair includes 100% UVA and UVB protection, a branded croc-embossed protective pouch, and a cleaning cloth for easy care on the go. This is the vintage oval frame updated for today's style—nostalgic yet contemporary, timeless yet fresh. Each pair includes a branded croc-embossed pouch and cleaning cloth for easy care on the go.

items.name: Heaven Mayhem BOOK BOX

items.description_en: The Jewelry Book Box Collection is Heaven Mayhem’s sculptural approach to storage — where design and function meet. Disguised as timeless hardcovers, each Book Box opens to reveal a hidden interior, thoughtfully designed to store earrings, rings, necklaces, or other keepsakes. Crafted with premium materials, these boxes elevate your space while keeping your jewelry collection organized. Place them on a vanity, dresser, bookshelf, or coffee table to add a refined accent to any room. Perfect as a gift box, storage solution, or decorative display, the Jewelry Book Box is more than organization — it’s a design statement. Pair with your Heaven Mayhem jewelry collection for a complete look that blends sculptural sensibility with everyday functionality.

items.description_en: Julia Statement Necklace The perfect everyday statement piece. Julia brings effortless sophistication to your daily rotation with its carefully proportioned bead and clean lines. This is the kind of necklace that transforms simple outfits into polished looks—refined enough for important meetings, relaxed enough for weekend coffee dates. Bold enough to elevate a basic tee and jeans, refined enough to complement your favorite blazer, Julia finds that perfect middle ground between subtle and striking. The thoughtfully designed length works beautifully for both solo wear and layering, flattering various necklines and adapting seamlessly to your personal style. Whether you're dressing up or down, Julia adds that finishing touch that makes you look more put-together instantly. It's the kind of piece that works with everything in your wardrobe without trying too hard. The effortless statement piece your wardrobe has been waiting for.

items.name: Heaven Mayhem PRIZE EARRINGS

items.description_en: The Prize Earrings bring timeless, vintage-inspired elegance to your everyday rotation. A polished metal frame outlines rich enamel for a refined statement that moves easily from office to evening and across seasons. Built for comfort, the lightweight construction sits effortlessly on the ear while the durable brass base and luxurious gold or silver-plating finish maintain a luminous shine and resist everyday wear. The silhouette is chic without trying too hard—an instant upgrade for denim, knits, tailoring, and dresses. Choose your colorway to set the tone: Black/Gold for classic warmth and contrast, Black/Silver for a cool, modern edge, Burgundy for a subtle pop of rich color, and Cream for a soft, versatile neutral. items.description_en: The Mini Knot Earrings are Heaven Mayhem’s modern take on sculptural jewelry — bold yet wearable. Featuring our signature twisted knot silhouette, these earrings are designed to make an impact without overpowering your look. Their smooth, high-shine finish catches the light from every angle, adding a sculptural edge to your everyday wardrobe. Crafted in gold-plated, silver-plated, or mixed-metal finishes on durable brass, the Mini Knot Earrings are built to last while staying surprisingly lightweight. Their hollow design ensures comfort all day long, even for sensitive ears. From denim to dresses, these earrings are the versatile piece you’ll reach for again and again. Style them solo for a clean, modern statement, or pair with other Heaven Mayhem pieces to create a layered, editorial-inspired look. For pierced ears only.
